description: Implementation of EmailCampaignReadPlatformService for reading email campaign data from the database, including methods for retrieving campaigns and business rules, with internal mappers for SQL result sets.

classes.name: EmailCampaignReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to read email campaign data and business rules from the database.

classes.name: EmailCampaignMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL result set rows to EmailCampaignData objects.

classes.name: BusinessRuleMapper
classes.description: ResultSetExtractor implementation for extracting list of EmailBusinessRulesData from SQL result set.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves all email business rules with report type 'Email'.

methods.name: retrieveOneTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a single email business rule template by resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific email campaign by resource ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllScheduleActiveCampaign
methods.description: Retrieves all active scheduled email campaigns.
